messages:
elena: @here Quick billing heads-up :wave:

elena: Starting next Monday we'll change invoice rounding rules from per-line rounding to per-invoice rounding (cents). This reduces tiny over/undercharges on multi-line invoices.

michael: Why the switch now?

elena: Two reasons: accounting asked for cleaner P&L alignment and customers reported noise when many micro-line items accumulate.

devon: Any backend changes I should watch for?

elena: Yes — billing service will switch calculations in /billing/core at deploy. Devs should expect a schema bump to invoice_summary.total_cents and one extra field invoice_summary.rounding_note.

devon: ETA for deploy?

elena: Deployment window is Monday 03:00-04:00 UTC. We'll run migration script that reconciles open invoices.

samira: How does this affect free tier and trial credits?

elena: Free slabs are being realigned: the free-tier slabs will now apply at the invoice level instead of per-route. Practically some customers will see slightly larger free allocations for multi-route usage; others slightly less. Net impact minimal.

product-ops: Do CS and Sales need customer outreach?

elena: We will surface a banner in Console + automated emails to accounts with >$100/month usage affected by >$1 net change. CS/Sales will get a CSV report by Monday morning.

billing-bot: [info] dry-run reconciliation completed: 1.2% of invoices show delta > $1 in sample window

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: Monday 03:00 UTC — rollback window 30m

michael: Any edge cases? timezone or prorated subscriptions?

elena: Prorated subscriptions use the same per-invoice rounding so small changes possible. Please flag any suspense account postings during Monday reconciliation.

devon: I'll add monitoring on invoice.total variance and an alert if > 0.5% of invoices change by > $5

elena: Thanks — final doc in #docs/billing will be published after the dry run passes. Ping me for the CSV.

michael: :thumbsup:

samira: noted, prepping CS messaging templates.

elena: Closing thread — will post a follow-up postmortem if any regressions occur.
